slides.texte_overlay:
Road trip rules every
man should follow

1. Driver picks the music

Shotgun keeps him awake.

2. Fill up at half a tank

Never gamble on the next station.

3. Learn where you're going

The history of the towns.
One fact per stop.

3. Learn where you're going

I read up on each stop
on the Sophia app.

slides.texte_overlay:
4. Eat where the locals eat

Never the highway chain.

5. Take the scenic exit

The best memories
are off the plan.
